# Elemental Shaman — Raid (group)

[Shaman](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Elemental

**[Elemental (optimized)](../research/raid/builds/opt-elemental-dps-raid-dps.md)** (31/7/13) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/shaman/60/5500301303113051-052-05305-4)

## How to play

**Before the pull:** **Lightning Bolt**.

**Keep up all fight:** **Searing Totem**.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Flame Shock**: keep it on the target
2. **Lava Burst**
3. **Chain Lightning** when Clearcasting is active
4. **Lightning Bolt**

**Lightning Bolt** is your filler: cast it whenever nothing above is ready.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*
